g.text: DUAL-LAYER FRAMEWORK: 7 EXHAUSTIVE HTF STRUCTURAL POIS ➔ 5-PILLAR VALIDATION GATE ➔ 6 LTF SURGICAL EXECUTION TRIGGERS
STAGE 1: HIGHER TIMEFRAME POI DISCOVERY (DAILY / H4 / H1 / M30)
EXHAUSTIVE PRICE GEOMETRY — LOCATION PRECEDES TRIGGER
STAGE 2: QUANTITATIVE POI VALIDATION GATE (ALL 5 FILTERS MUST PASS)
• Origin move must close past structure
STAGE 3: SURGICAL LOWER TIMEFRAME EXECUTION TRIGGERS (M1 / M5 ONLY)
EVALUATED STRICTLY UPON CONTACT WITH ACTIVE VALIDATED POI
SL: Below origin base of Wave 1
• Effortless reversal = Path of least resist
• Limit order placed at 50% FVG / OB
SL: Below origin OB candle low
STAGE 4: EXECUTION, POSITION SIZING & RISK MANAGEMENT ENGINE
• Lot Size = (Account Equity × Risk%) / (SL Points × Tick Value)
• Max Spread Filter: < 35 points on Gold (XAUUSD)
• Move SL to Breakeven at 1.0× ATR expansion move
• 100% position runs to HTF structural target
• Automatic 4-Hour trading pause after 3 consecutive losses
• Prevents drawdowns during chop & non-trending regimes
• Automatic cancel of pending limits 15 min prior to Red News
• Covers US CPI, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), FOMC rate decisions
• Resumes trading 15 min post-news after volatility stabilizes
MASTER SMC SPECIFICATION MATRIX (7 HTF POIS × 6 LTF TRIGGERS)
Base accumulation low followed by higher high breakout
Buy Limit at origin base demand candle top edge
Clean breakout beyond prior swing high/low
Limit order at broken horizontal flip line or nested FVG
Liquidity sweep at peak + aggressive breakdown of low
Sell Limit at broken intermediate support shelf
Left Shoulder + Head sweep + Lower Low break
Sell Limit placed at exact Left Shoulder horizontal level
Sell Limit at unmitigated High 2 extreme Order Block
Double top formation + displacement break below neckline
Sell Limit placed at broken neckline shelf
Initial resistance bounce + breakdown + full rally return
Sell Limit at horizontal resistance ceiling
Contact with HTF POI + local swing sweep + structural break
Limit order at origin Higher Low / Lower High pullback
Buy/Sell Limit strictly at Fibonacci 50.0% – 61.8% zone
Dying 5-wave wedge advances into HTF POI (Wave 5 sweep)
Direct sniper limit order at Wave 5 boundary trendline touch
Bar 2 engulfs Bar 1 with Volume(Bar 2) < Volume(Bar 1)
Market execution immediately upon Bar 2 close
Displacement candle breaks swing structure leaving 3-bar FVG
Limit order at 50% FVG midpoint or color-free origin OB
